scope: Read-only source audit; clean git status before/after; no builds, tests, network or repository edits. No repository/checked intermediate AGENTS.md or tracked PDD markers found. Parent owns story/architecture. Dates are git committer dates, not mtime.

patterns.pattern: Capability libraries, independent of source chapters
patterns.adaptation: Rust capability modules with cohesive public types/functions and private state. Chapters/papers supply examples, provenance and regression fixtures calling shared APIs. No functions-per-chapter; split crates only at meaningful API/dependency boundaries.

patterns.pattern: Tests mirror source capabilities and import public interfaces
patterns.adaptation: Rust internal unit tests plus public-API integration tests, organized by mathematical capability and identities, with book/paper citations as provenance.

patterns.pattern: Separate error interpretation from underlying operations
patterns.commit: ce74fd6 / 26c1603; older source, not June 2026 implementation
patterns.adaptation: Result<T, DomainError> for preconditions, unsupported operations and computation limits; separate IO/CLI adapters. Do not port virtual functors, mutable last-error or errno literally.

cautions.caution: Source/test existence does not establish correctness or production readiness
cautions.finding: Parser does not reset after pressure or a non-alert temperature; subsequent bytes accumulate. Test has TODO audit and expects false/READ_TEMPERATURE. UnionFind exposes state and unchecked indices. Static observations only; no tests executed. Require protected invariants and meaningful negative/control tests.

cautions.caution: Improve dependency and test isolation instead of translating CMake structure
cautions.finding: Unconditional fetched test/json dependencies and UnitTests; hardcoded errno 97/English error; broad aggregate Check linkage. Rust dev-dependencies, optional adapters/features, reproducible locks and portable domain-error assertions are better analogues. June dependency maintenance does not make 2023 source recent.
